## Time Complexity

**Owner: Teammate 5**

- Must match the variant Teammate 3 implemented
- Best case, average case, worst case
- For each case, state what tree shape / query pattern produces it
  (e.g. balanced vs. skewed tree)

## Space Complexity

- Memory used by preprocessing structures (e.g. ancestor tables,
  Euler tour array, sparse table) vs. the tree itself
- How space scales with `n` (number of nodes)
